newsitem.title: USA: Exide sets terms for debenture purchase.
newsitem.headline: Exide sets terms for debenture purchase.

text.p: Exide Corp said Monday it set terms for a previously announced offer to purchase debentures.

The company said it is offering a price equal to $962.88 per $1,000 principal amount for the outstanding 12-1/4 percent senior subordinated deferred coupon debentures due 2004 for those holders who delivered a consent on or prior to April 22, 1997, and $952.88 per $1,000 for those holders who tendered after April 22, 1997.

The purchase price for the debentures was determined by reference to the bid-side yield on the 5-3/8 percent U.S. Treasury Note due November 30, 1997, on Friday, May 2, 1997, which was 5.846 percent plus 50 basis points.
